title: Promise Proximity Step on Insured Return
content:
# Bench Standing Order: The Promise Proximity Step on an Insured Return

## How the turnarounds are counted

A service level of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service carries a target turnaround and a rush turnaround, both set in business days. Where the day a piece is promised back is measured against them, both turnarounds are counted in calendar days, taking 7 calendar days to 5 working days.

## The step

Where the day the piece is promised back falls inside the level's rush turnaround counted from the handling date, the express promise step of 40 percent is added to the shipping rate.

Where it falls inside the level's target turnaround but not inside that rush turnaround, the standard promise step of 18 percent is added.

In any other case no step is added on this ground.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

At a level whose rush turnaround is 5 business days and whose target turnaround is 14 business days, the rush turnaround counted in calendar days comes to 7 calendar days and the target to 19.6 calendar days.

| The day the piece is promised back | Step added |
|---|---|
| 3 calendar days from the handling date | the express promise step, 40 percent |
| 7 calendar days from the handling date | the express promise step, 40 percent, that day falling inside the rush turnaround |
| 12 calendar days from the handling date | the standard promise step, 18 percent |
| 25 calendar days from the handling date | none on this ground |
